newsitem.title: USA: MSRB to notify firms soon on price dissemination.
newsitem.headline: MSRB to notify firms soon on price dissemination.

text.p: The Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board will request information from bond dealers shortly in preparation for a Jan. 1, 1998, deadline aimed at vastly improving price dissemination in the municipal bond market, an MSRB official said Friday.

"We will send a letter to all dealer members in the industry in the next 10 days asking you for contact persons, what types of back office systems you have, (and) how do you intend to interface with the board," MSRB executive director Christopher Taylor said at the annual meeting of PSA The Bond Market Trade Association here.
Taylor said the board needs the information to launch industry wide testing this summer of price dissemination by dealers to institutional and retail muni investors.

New MSRB rules already require dealers to report dealer-to- dealer trades to the board. But beginning next January, all dealer-customer trades, including trades with institutional and retail buyers, must be reported daily to the board.

"Some of that information will be made available for transaction (reporting) purposes the next morning," Taylor said. "All of the information will flow into a central data base," that regulators can use to monitor price reporting in the muni market, Taylor said.
"It's not easy," he said. "It will mean all of you will have to have some changes in back office procedures."

But Taylor said the job may not be as hard for industry as the board thought. "Early discussions we've had with firms that we've been working with suggest that it's not as difficult as we assumed it might be," Taylor said.
